name: Sport Clubs Company
summary: Sport Clubs Company owns and manages men's and women's fitness centers in Saudi Arabia. Its brands include Body Masters, a fitness center for men providing amenities, including cardio and strength areas, fitness studios, indoor cycling, functional training zones, football fields, swimming pools and spa areas, flexible personal training programs, and martial arts areas; Body Motions, a ladies' club that provides amenities, including cardio and strength areas, fully equipped group exercise studios, indoor cycling, functional training zones, swimming pools and spa areas, and flexible personal training programs; and Body Experts, which provides corporate wellness services and events.
